title: API: a part created through the public API adds exactly one Part Library entry
custom_preconds: Env https://sv10647.qa.shopview.com (S2 shop; locations Staging Heavy Duty and Staging Lethbridge). Logged in as Admin (or a default Parts Manager): Part Library & Inventory View, Create & Edit and Delete, and See Financial Data. Public API key WITH parts:write. Requests to POST /api/v1/parts on the sv10647 API host, each with the location set to the location named in the step and the other fields the public API create requires (category etc.). Data: the new number QAPL-API-1 (search the Part Library first: no entry).
custom_steps:
1. Parts > Part Library > search "QAPL-API-1".
  2. POST /api/v1/parts with the parts:write key for Staging Heavy Duty, body {"part_number":"QAPL-API-1","name":"QA API part 1", …}.
  3. Parts > Part Library > search "QAPL-API-1" > open the entry.
  4. POST /api/v1/parts again with the exact same "part_number":"QAPL-API-1", this time for Staging Lethbridge.
  5. Parts > Part Library > search "QAPL-API-1" > open the entry.
  6. Cleanup: Inventory at each location > open QAPL-API-1 > Delete Part.
custom_expected:
1. No entry is found.
  2. 201; the response returns the new part with part_number QAPL-API-1.
  3. Exactly one entry QAPL-API-1; its parts table lists the part at Staging Heavy Duty.
  4. 201; a part is created at Staging Lethbridge.
  5. Still exactly one entry QAPL-API-1 (the exact number linked to it, no second entry); its parts table lists both locations.
  6. Both parts are deleted.
